status_note: FuncProto/FuncCallSpecs no-return flag lifecycle projection for CALLSPEC-NORETURN-WIRE-0001 slice (a): constructor defaults, explicit set/clear/idempotence through the FuncCallSpecs inherited surface, copyFlowEffects' is_inline|no_return one-way subset overwrite (the flow.cc:664 queryCall channel), full-copy and callspec-clone propagation with op rebind and active-input reset, the documented absence of any void->noreturn inference, and the decode/encode attribute channel. Byte-matches the locked oracle on all six cases with empty stderr on both sides. The flow.rs consumption wiring (checkForFlowModification's is_no_return read, queryCall's copyFlowEffects call, truncateIndirectJump's setNoReturn) is slice (b) under the flow lease.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Ghidra copyFlowEffects mutates the destination flags through the C++ reference receiver and reads the source through a const FuncProto&; Rugra takes &mut self / &FuncProto and delegates to the composed prototype - both are in-place mutations of a single callspec object, no output parameters.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: the covered functions have no loops except FuncProto::decode's attribute walk (document order over the <prototype> attributes, breaking on attribId==0) and clone's fresh-constructor path; Rugra's decode mirrors the same attribute loop with next_attribute_id()==0 termination and the same element order for <returnsym> children.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters or accumulators in the covered slice; the flags uint4 is a pure bit set whose per-bit clear-then-OR lifecycle is exercised stepwise (set, idempotent re-set, clear, subset overwrite in both directions).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sort keys; the flag comparisons exercised are isNoReturn/isInline equality observations and encode's attribute-presence decision, mirroring fspec.cc:4567's (flags&(is_inline|no_return)) subset comparison which Rugra models as direct bool equality (fspec.rs is_compatible).

cases: default_ctor: FuncProto::FuncProto (fspec.cc:3778) flags==0 so isNoReturn/isInline default false; FuncCallSpecs(PcodeOp*) (fspec.cc:4924) inherits the same false defaults through the FuncProto base and leaves the CALLIND entry address invalid

explicit_set_idempotent: setNoReturn(true) (fspec.hh:1439) sets the bit, a repeated set is idempotent, setNoReturn(false) clears it; driven both on a plain FuncProto and through the FuncCallSpecs inherited surface (the flow.cc:747 truncateIndirectJump surface)

copy_flow_effects: FuncProto::copyFlowEffects (fspec.cc:3806-3812) copies only the is_inline|no_return subset as a one-way overwrite (clear-then-OR: callee{1,1}->fc{0,0} gives {1,1}; callee{0,0} clears back to {0,0}; callee{0,1} gives {0,1}) and never leaks the source's modellock (non-subset flag); this is the flow.cc:664 queryCall noreturn propagation channel

full_copy_and_clone: FuncProto::copy (fspec.cc:3789) copies the flags wholesale; FuncCallSpecs::clone (fspec.cc:4964-4977) preserves the copied FuncProto bits, rebinds to the new op, and resets the active-input recovery state

void_no_inference: a void-returning prototype (setInternal + a decoded <prototype> with a void <returnsym>) stays isNoReturn()==false - Ghidra's fspec layer has no void->noreturn inference; the bit's only producers are the XML attribute, OptionNoReturn, direct setNoReturn, and copyFlowEffects/copy propagation

decode_encode_channel: FuncProto::decode (fspec.cc:4720-4722) sets the bit from noreturn="true", leaves it clear when the attribute is absent, and leaves it clear for noreturn="false"; FuncProto::encode (fspec.cc:4642-4643) emits the attribute only when the bit is set

out_of_scope_observations.note: Ghidra copyFlowEffects also copies injectid (fspec.cc:3811); Rugra's FuncProto has no injection-id storage (set_inject_id is the INJECT-0001 stub) so the copy cannot be projected; owned by INJECT-0001.

FuncProto::isCompatible's (fspec.cc:4567) noreturn-arm comparison is mirrored as a direct bool compare in fspec.rs is_compatible; projecting it through this fixture needs model-bearing prototypes on both sides, covered by the FUNCPROTO-MODEL-BIND-0001 fixture family.

OptionNoReturn (options.cc:347-366) sets the bit on a named function's FuncProto through the symbol table; Rugra's options layer has no registered noreturn option yet - the call-site effect of that channel is identical to the decode channel projected here.

flow.rs consumption wiring (check_for_flow_modification's is_no_return read at the flow.rs:120-123 FuncCallSpecsExt stub, query_call's copy_flow_effects integration, truncate_indirect_jump's set_no_return(true)) is CALLSPEC-NORETURN-WIRE-0001 slice (b), blocked on the flow lease.
